name: Taajir
description: A robust inventory management and point-of-sale system designed for small to medium-sized businesses, featuring real-time stock tracking, sales analytics and customized features to streamline operations.

name: Ludo
description: A browser take on the classic board game with AI opponents, pass-and-play, and real-time online lobbies, kept in sync through Socket.IO events and saved game snapshots.

name: News Updates
description: A news aggregator that pulls RSS feeds into country-aware categories, ranks stories by priority and reader endorsements, and comes with a full admin panel for feeds, intervals, and ad slots.

name: INCNXT
description: An online US company-formation service: data-driven pricing by state and package, a transactional checkout that creates the account on the way, a formation status flow, and an admin panel built from scratch.

name: Distrobooks
description: Subscription bookkeeping for consignment distributors: purchase orders, sales, returns, a ledger with full audit history, public stock menus, QR scanning, and Stripe-billed plans.

name: LearnYourWay
description: A private-tutoring marketplace with tutor applications, trial lessons, Stripe-paid packages, a live 100ms classroom, a notice-based reschedule and refund policy, and tutor payouts.

name: Ark Clam Academy
description: A workplace training app for German companies, with Whisper-generated English and German subtitles, translated quizzes, a fully localised Flutter client, and WebSocket team chat.

name: ClassConnect
description: A school learning management system where I built the component library the whole interface is made from, then wired it to a FastAPI backend with server-side auth and role-based routes.

name: ResNow
description: A restaurant reservation dashboard. I built the bookings timeline, which lays each table out against fifteen-minute slots on a CSS grid, plus the shared navigation and form components.

name: DreamUni
description: A marketplace where verified university students share their winning personal statements with applicants, with admin approval of offer letters and Stripe Connect split payouts.

name: Raz Tutoring
description: A bold marketing site for a small online tutoring business, built in a few weeks on my own Svelte component kit, with the start of a dashboard for tutors and students.
